additional_info.subject: Report of connectors showing a no communication status Sicharge D Charging Station – S/N:  MPR8170002535
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I would like to report an issue with a Sicharge D charging station, serial number MPR8170002535.
Issue observed:
The station has been in an "No communication" on the charge point, "unavailable" on the connector 1 DC CCS plug, 300kW and "unavailable" on the connector 2 DC CCS plug,300kW,  since June 03, 2025 at 09:88:54, which is the time of the last status change.
Please investigate and take the necessary actions as soon as possible. We would also appreciate a report on the root cause and any corrective measures planned.
Best regards,
Janusan ESVARANATHAN | Supervision and maintenance engineer | Mob: +33 745 654 964
SAS AUTORECHARGE | WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR | +33 970 755 400

additional_info.subject: RE: 0428694-DC/Si-D/-FR[MP / R8 170002535] Connector showing no communication CRM:02888000046
additional_info.body:
Dear J. Esvaranathan,
I hope this message finds you well.
We would like to inform you that the recent unavailability of the outlets was due to a temporary ChargerOperationMode error. This issue has now been resolved, and both outlets are currently healthy and available.
However, we have observed a Power Converter error on DC3. Our regional team has been notified and will be reaching out to you shortly to address this matter.
We appreciate your patience and understanding. Please feel free to reach out if you have any further questions or concerns.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
